subject: Ganon
text: Ganon slashes with his huge swords, causing Link to lose his Master Sword.

evidence.quote:
Ganon slashes with his huge swords, making Link lose
his Master Sword.

subject: Ganon
text: Link can stun Ganon with Light Arrows or roll between his legs to get behind him, then slash his tail with the Biggoron's Sword.

evidence.quote:
The way to defeat this monster is to either stun it
by shooting Light Arrows then going behind it, or rolling between its legs.
Either way, slash his tail with the Biggoron's Sword.

subject: Master Sword
text: Link is able to get the Master Sword back after dealing some damage to Ganon.

evidence.quote:
After dealing some
damage, you're able to get your Master Sword back.

subject: Ganon
text: When Ganon falls, Zelda holds him down while the sages power Link's sword to deliver the final slash to his head.

evidence.quote:
After some more damage, Ganon will fall, and Zelda will keep him down,
telling you to deal the final blow. The sages will power your sword for the
final hit. Just head up to his head, and slash.
